topic: Myth: a full rewrite is the fastest way to fix a messy app
caption:
Myth: “Our app is a mess. We need to rewrite it from scratch.” 🧱

A full rewrite feels like a fresh start, but it usually means months of rebuilding features you already have, while the current app still needs fixing.

Most messy apps get better faster by improving them in steps: fix the slowest or most fragile parts first, add tests around them, and replace pieces one at a time while the app keeps running.

Sometimes a rebuild really is the right call, like when the tech is no longer supported. It should be a decision, not a reflex.

Agree or disagree? Tell us in the comments. 👇
